name: Endpoint recovery
description: PC-2 starts isolated. The operator restores it; connectivity that was permitted comes back and the SIEM records it.

presentation.objective: Show that restoring an endpoint removes the isolation and returns its permitted connectivity.
presentation.security_rule: EDR isolation policy while isolated; after restore the normal rules apply again (STAFF-IN rule 100, IPS-1 inspection).
presentation.explanation: While isolated PC-2's pings are dropped at its own agent. At 5 s the operator restores it (Restore Endpoint in its panel, or scripted in the automated run): the state returns to healthy, the SIEM records it, and the HTTPS session at 8 s reaches APP-SRV.
expected: PC-2's pings before the restore are dropped with reason edr_isolated
The restore changes PC-2 to healthy and the SIEM records it
PC-2's HTTPS session after the restore is delivered
